cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll settle this before Sunday lunch. I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me. You owe me an admission just as embarrassing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then pick your own subject. But it has to cost you something; what scares you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her that at lunch. I'll sit beside you; mine had an audience too.

reason: A now concedes the subject and offers companionship while preserving the exact debt of equal public vulnerability; remove decorative rank wording.
